title: Sayari trade-record snapshot: vape imports into the United States

source.name: Sayari Graph (via the Sayari MCP server)
source.access: Subscription. Entity links require a Sayari login.

caveats: Trade records name the shipper and receiver declared on customs paperwork. They do not prove which factory physically made a product.
Sayari resolves names across datasets. A record's shipper can be a related or mis-matched entity; check identifiers and addresses before relying on a match.
Sayari risk flags are screening signals derived from product, country, and network data. They are not findings of labor abuse by the named company.
Searching by HS code 854340 alone returned many unrelated companies (fencing, bamboo, metal products) with 2020-dated records. Product-description searches were more reliable.
